Does drinking alcohol on a full stomach affect blood alcohol levels?
questions.help:
ALCOHOL AND OTHER DRUGS    
     
16.1 Factors affecting alcohol limits
Whether the stomach is empty or full. The amount of alcohol in the blood is higher when drinking on an empty stomach. This is affected by the amount of food and the type of food, which are both factors in varying the speed at which the alcohol enters into the blood. However, this only slows the absorption, in the end the alcohol always reaches the blood.
Age. Children under 18 and those over 65 are often more vulnerable to the effects of alcohol.
(Página 42 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.help:
5 Pedestrians
 
5.1 Travelling in a pedestrian zone
As a general rule, it is prohibited for any class of vehicle to drive on pavements or other pedestrian areas.
Pedestrians should walk in areas particularly highlighted for them, such as pedestrian zones, walkways and pavements (paths). When these areas do not exist or are not practicable, then the pedestrians should use the hard shoulder (if one exists) or as a last resort, the roadway towards the outside edge and furthest away from traffic as possible.
(Página 55 del manual 'Learning to drive')

questions.help:
3 Moderate speed
 
All drivers should travel at a moderate speed and, if necessary, even stop their vehicle when the circumstances require it. The following are circumstances that are likely to be encountered and where speed should be moderated to take into account the given situation:
In the proximity of level crossings, roundabouts and junctions where you do not have priority. If the junction is particularly hazardous and visibility is seriously reduced, the speed of vehicles approaching should not exceed 50 km/h.
(Página 172 del manual 'Learning to drive')
